text.p: These are the leading stories in the Kenyan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Alleged Kenyan "guerrilla" killed in car accident as he prepared to confess about subversive activities.
- President Daniel arap Moi says liberalisation of coffee and tea industries, promised back in 1992, will be completed by mid-November.
- Chairman and three senior officials of Finance Bank Limited, now under Central Bank control, charged in Nairobi court with publishing false accounts.
- President Moi announces exemption of the Kenya Tea Development Authority and Coffee Board of Kenya from State Corporations Act.
